     <div class="loading-spin dark large centered"></div>

</div>
<div class="row"  id="row-621779976">
	<div id="col-1691212679" class="col small-12 large-12"  >
				<div class="col-inner"  >
	<div id="gap-695897714" class="gap-element clearfix" style="display:block; height:auto;">
<style></style>
	</div>
<p style="font-family: 'Josefin Sans',sans-seri;"><span style="font-family: josefinsans-regular; color: #282828;">Jaguaribe Lodge&amp;Kite has become a reference spot in Ceará for kitesurfing, thanks to its privileged location, close to a wind farm, and where the Jaguaribe River meets the sea.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: josefinsans-regular; color: #282828;">Today, with the new kite center Jaguaribe Kite, and a team of 10 instructors, with at least fluent and certified English, the structure is the largest in Ceará offering a school for adults, young people and children, a store and equipment rental.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: josefinsans-regular; color: #282828;">The big news is the arrival of a new modality: wing surfing, a sport in which you glide over the water using an inflatable wing and a SUP foil, it does not depend on very strong winds and can be practiced at low or high tide.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: josefinsans-regular; color: #282828;">The center also has an ideal space for supporting sailors or for resting after sailing. For passing sailors, it is possible to rent equipment. There is also a store with sports equipment.  </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: josefinsans-regular; color: #282828;"> You will also find the Jaguaribe Arena, an area with 6 beach tennis courts that can be used by guests and visitors. Other activities can also be experienced at the center, such as slackline, frescobol, balance board and stand up paddle or laser tag rental or tour. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: josefinsans-regular; color: #282828;">With so many options, it&#8217;s almost impossible not to surrender to the waters of Fortim!</span></p>
		</div>
					</div>
</div>
</div>
